counterargs.read: This looks like a clean, idiosyncratic catalyst — Nvidia's earnings — rather than a macro regime shift. The follow-through into SOXX/QQQ/SPY and the vol compression are real and worth respecting, but the structural liquidity picture (Fed balance sheet, TGA, reserves) hasn't moved at all, and nominal yields haven't come down to confirm a genuine 'easing' narrative. Treat this as an equity-specific tailwind that coexists with, rather than resolves, the macro uncertainty still sitting ahead of Warsh's keynote tomorrow.
